row.name: band_view
row.definition: select "ontology"."node_version"."id", "ontology"."node_version"."version", "ontology"."node_version"."action", "ontology"."party_version"."handle", "ontology"."guild_version"."motto", "ontology"."band_version"."genre", "ontology"."node_version"."timestamp", "version_zero"."timestamp" as "created_at" from "ontology"."band_version" inner join "ontology"."node_version" on (("ontology"."band_version"."id" = "ontology"."node_version"."id") and ("ontology"."band_version"."version" = "ontology"."node_version"."version")) inner join "ontology"."node" on "ontology"."band_version"."id" = "ontology"."node"."id" inner join "ontology"."party_version" on (("ontology"."band_version"."id" = "ontology"."party_version"."id") and ("ontology"."band_version"."version" = "ontology"."party_version"."version")) inner join "ontology"."guild_version" on (("ontology"."band_version"."id" = "ontology"."guild_version"."id") and ("ontology"."band_version"."version" = "ontology"."guild_version"."version")) cross join lateral (select  from "ontology"."realm_version" where (("ontology"."band_version"."id" = "ontology"."realm_version"."id") and ("ontology"."band_version"."version" = "ontology"."realm_version"."version")) offset 0) "tail" inner join "ontology"."node_version" "version_zero" on (("ontology"."band_version"."id" = "version_zero"."id") and ("version_zero"."version" = 0)) where not exists (select 1 from "ontology"."node_version" "newer" where (("newer"."id" = "ontology"."band_version"."id") and ("newer"."version" > "ontology"."band_version"."version")))

row.name: member_view
row.definition: select "ontology"."node_version"."id", "ontology"."node_version"."version", "ontology"."node_version"."action", "ontology"."party_version"."handle", "tail"."badge", "ontology"."member_version"."rank", "ontology"."node_version"."timestamp", "version_zero"."timestamp" as "created_at" from "ontology"."member_version" inner join "ontology"."node_version" on (("ontology"."member_version"."id" = "ontology"."node_version"."id") and ("ontology"."member_version"."version" = "ontology"."node_version"."version")) inner join "ontology"."node" on "ontology"."member_version"."id" = "ontology"."node"."id" inner join "ontology"."party_version" on (("ontology"."member_version"."id" = "ontology"."party_version"."id") and ("ontology"."member_version"."version" = "ontology"."party_version"."version")) cross join lateral (select "ontology"."member"."badge" from "ontology"."realm_version" inner join "ontology"."member" on "ontology"."member_version"."id" = "ontology"."member"."id" where (("ontology"."member_version"."id" = "ontology"."realm_version"."id") and ("ontology"."member_version"."version" = "ontology"."realm_version"."version")) offset 0) "tail" inner join "ontology"."node_version" "version_zero" on (("ontology"."member_version"."id" = "version_zero"."id") and ("version_zero"."version" = 0)) where not exists (select 1 from "ontology"."node_version" "newer" where (("newer"."id" = "ontology"."member_version"."id") and ("newer"."version" > "ontology"."member_version"."version")))

row.name: party_view
row.definition: select "ontology"."node_version"."id", "ontology"."node_version"."version", "ontology"."node_version"."action", "ontology"."party_version"."handle", "ontology"."node_version"."timestamp", "version_zero"."timestamp" as "created_at" from "ontology"."party_version" inner join "ontology"."node_version" on (("ontology"."party_version"."id" = "ontology"."node_version"."id") and ("ontology"."party_version"."version" = "ontology"."node_version"."version")) inner join "ontology"."node" on "ontology"."party_version"."id" = "ontology"."node"."id" cross join lateral (select  from "ontology"."realm_version" where (("ontology"."party_version"."id" = "ontology"."realm_version"."id") and ("ontology"."party_version"."version" = "ontology"."realm_version"."version")) offset 0) "tail" inner join "ontology"."node_version" "version_zero" on (("ontology"."party_version"."id" = "version_zero"."id") and ("version_zero"."version" = 0)) where not exists (select 1 from "ontology"."node_version" "newer" where (("newer"."id" = "ontology"."party_version"."id") and ("newer"."version" > "ontology"."party_version"."version")))

row.name: realm_view
row.definition: select "ontology"."node_version"."id", "ontology"."node_version"."version", "ontology"."node_version"."action", "ontology"."node"."type", "ontology"."node_version"."timestamp", "version_zero"."timestamp" as "created_at" from "ontology"."realm_version" inner join "ontology"."node_version" on (("ontology"."realm_version"."id" = "ontology"."node_version"."id") and ("ontology"."realm_version"."version" = "ontology"."node_version"."version")) inner join "ontology"."node" on "ontology"."realm_version"."id" = "ontology"."node"."id" inner join "ontology"."node_version" "version_zero" on (("ontology"."realm_version"."id" = "version_zero"."id") and ("version_zero"."version" = 0)) where ((not exists (select 1 from "ontology"."node_version" "newer" where (("newer"."id" = "ontology"."realm_version"."id") and ("newer"."version" > "ontology"."realm_version"."version")))) and (case "ontology"."node"."type" when 'party' then exists (select 1 from "ontology"."party_version" where (("ontology"."realm_version"."id" = "ontology"."party_version"."id") and ("ontology"."realm_version"."version" = "ontology"."party_version"."version")) offset 0) when 'member' then ((exists (select 1 from "ontology"."party_version" where (("ontology"."realm_version"."id" = "ontology"."party_version"."id") and ("ontology"."realm_version"."version" = "ontology"."party_version"."version")) offset 0)) and (exists (select 1 from "ontology"."member_version" where (("ontology"."realm_version"."id" = "ontology"."member_version"."id") and ("ontology"."realm_version"."version" = "ontology"."member_version"."version")) offset 0)) and (exists (select 1 from "ontology"."member" where "ontology"."realm_version"."id" = "ontology"."member"."id" offset 0))) when 'band' then ((exists (select 1 from "ontology"."party_version" where (("ontology"."realm_version"."id" = "ontology"."party_version"."id") and ("ontology"."realm_version"."version" = "ontology"."party_version"."version")) offset 0)) and (exists (select 1 from "ontology"."guild_version" where (("ontology"."realm_version"."id" = "ontology"."guild_version"."id") and ("ontology"."realm_version"."version" = "ontology"."guild_version"."version")) offset 0)) and (exists (select 1 from "ontology"."band_version" where (("ontology"."realm_version"."id" = "ontology"."band_version"."id") and ("ontology"."realm_version"."version" = "ontology"."band_version"."version")) offset 0))) else false end))
